description.content:
The Publer API (v1) is a RESTful JSON interface for automating social media workflows - scheduling, publishing, media management and analytics - across Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Google Business Profiles, WordPress and Telegram. Authentication is an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer-API YOUR_API_KEY` together with a `Publer-Workspace-Id` header. The API is available exclusively to Publer Business users.
